text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (us-west-2). 5m error rate ~11%. Paging oncall-alex and SRE. PD incident created: INC-2761.
oncall-alex: I'm looking. starting a short timeline, switching channel to this thread for logs. tagging @sre-maya and @eng-runtime-sam.
sre-maya: Oncall here, taking lead. quick check: are we seeing gateway-side 502/504 or backend 5xx?
eng-runtime-sam: Gateway shows lots of upstream retry loops. examples in logs below. appears to be repeated upstream CONNRESET + immediate retry_count increments.
eng-runtime-sam: ```
2026-04-11T15:03:21Z gateway us-west-2 req_id=abc123 corr_id=CORR-7f4a2 upstream=runtime-10.2.3.5 status=502 error="ECONNRESET" retry=1
2026-04-11T15:03:21Z gateway us-west-2 req_id=abc123 corr_id=CORR-7f4a2 upstream=runtime-10.2.3.5 status=502 error="ECONNRESET" retry=2
2026-04-11T15:03:22Z gateway us-west-2 req_id=abc123 corr_id=CORR-7f4a2 upstream=runtime-10.2.3.5 status=502 error="ECONNRESET" retry=3
```
sre-maya: Thanks. grabbing runtime pod logs for that corr_id now. please paste a sample trace id if you have it.
eng-runtime-sam: sample trace: TRACE-f2b9. runtime logs show abrupt TCP EOF at same timestamp and then JVM busy GC spikes around 15:02:50-15:03:10 for the same host.
ops-lin: I'm seeing increased egress latency from runtime to the embeddings service (10.x.y.z). p50/ p95 all climbing. could be downstream saturation.
product-jordan: FYI this started ~15:02; customer-facing errors reported by 3 customers (two active sessions each). marking severity high.
cust-ops-anna: alerted affected customers with temporary message: "We are investigating elevated errors for text generation in US-WEST-2; intermittent failures, no data loss."
eng-runtime-sam: quick mitigation idea: reduce concurrency for runtime pool and disable gateway automatic retries for 502/504 for 30m to avoid amplification. can we try fallback routing to model-variant:small-quant to relieve memory pressure?
sre-maya: Agreed. doing two-step: 1) throttle worker concurrency to 8 on the 3 busiest hosts. 2) set gateway retry policy: max_retries=0 for 502/504 for requests to /v1/generate in us-west-2. applying now.
deploy-bot: config-change: throttles/runtime_pool/us-west-2 -> concurrency=8 by oncall-alex at 2026-04-11T15:06:12Z :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: gateway-policy change applied (us-west-2) max_retries=0 :white_check_mark:
oncall-alex: Can people watch error rate now and report p95 latency?
eng-runtime-sam: after throttle + retries off: within 90s error rate dropped to ~3% and p95 latency improved slightly. still seeing isolated 502s with same corr_id prefix CORR-7f4a2.
sre-maya: Hypotheses so far:
- H1: downstream embeddings service is intermittently failing causing runtime to exceed connection limits -> ECONNRESET -> gateway retries amplify 5xx.
- H2: runtime host GC pause causing connection drops under load. GC spikes align with timestamps.
- H3: network flapping between runtime and embeddings (unlikely but possible after recent VPC change).
eng-runtime-sam: I've pulled full logs for CORR-7f4a2 and uploaded to secure-log-bucket: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2761234567/CORR-7f4a2.log (link shared in PD incident).
ops-lin: Added egress metrics dashboard for the window 14:55-15:10. embedding service error rate also shows bump starting 15:01.
product-jordan: Customer impact: 3 customers affected, estimated error surface ~0.2% of overall requests for the day but concentrated in sessions. CS notified.
oncall-alex: Good mitigation steps. keeping incident page open. SRE to keep monitoring for 30m and then decide next steps (rollforward, capacity add, or postmortem).
sre-maya: Next investigative actions: capture tcpdump between runtime and embeddings host for 10 minutes, correlate with GC logs and thread dumps for hosts that restarted connections. scheduling now.
eng-runtime-sam: taking thread dumps from runtime-10.2.3.5 and runtime-10.2.3.8. thread dumps show several threads blocked in http-client send; not obvious leak. GC logs show full GC at 15:02:49 on .5.
ops-lin: For visibility, adding a short-term alert: if gateway 5xx > 5% for 1m in us-west-2 -> auto-scale extra runtime nodes by +2 and notify SRE (will need vetting if we want autoscale for this pattern).
product-jordan: Noting decision: we will not route customers to another region yet (latency sensitive), prefer local mitigation.
cust-ops-anna: I'll keep CS updates concise: "Mitigation applied; errors reduced; detailed RCA to follow."
sre-maya: We should capture final timeline for RCA: 14:58 - slight increase in egress latency; 15:01 - embeddings error bump; 15:02:48 - runtime .5 full GC; 15:03 - gateway retries amplify -> peak 5xx; 15:06 - throttle + disable retries -> error rate drops.
oncall-alex: Handing off to SRE for post-incident RCA doc. leaving the thread open for log links and notes. great work, team :thumbsup:
sre-maya: Will create postmortem draft and include log links, corr-ids, timeline, and recommended action items (disable retry-on-5xx in gateway config by default, add GC/heap monitoring thresholds, consider embedding service capacity check).
eng-runtime-sam: saving sample corr_ids for RCA: CORR-7f4a2, CORR-9c1d0, CORR-2b8e6.
product-jordan: Any action items for product (customer communications / credits)? suggest follow-up with affected customers in 24h with RCA.
sre-maya: acknowledged. closing proactive page in 30m if metrics stay stable. I'll ping here when I publish the draft.
